title: County source group
description: One file per county under _meta/sources/. Counties are the unit of update checking: 36 counties on a dozen platforms move at unrelated rates, and a single manifest would make every county's drift one county's problem. Validated in CI via plugins.extra_schema_checks.

group.description: Must equal the filename without .yml, and the county slug without the -county suffix

crawl.description: THE ROBOTS DETERMINATION FOR THIS COUNTY, recorded so it is reviewable in a PR rather than buried in a fetcher. Five source hosts serve `User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /`; the operator's decision (PLAN.md Phase 12) is that the text of county law is authored by the county and the vendor is a host, not the author. `decision` records what was concluded FOR THIS COUNTY and `basis` records why, per source host.

decision.description: proceed: ingest. excluded: deliberately not ingested. unavailable: the host refused an honestly-identified agent at the HTTP layer, so there is nothing to decide — we do not retry disguised as a browser.

ai_block.description: true when robots.txt names an AI crawler and gives it Disallow: /

upstream_signal.description: Human note: what upstream mechanism announces a change here, and how often it actually moves. There is no county with a change feed, so this is usually 're-fetch and re-hash'.

family.description: Determines the subdirectory, and therefore the doc_type

sha256.description: Content hash as corpus-detect-changes computes it on a fresh fetch — NOT the document's source_sha256, which hashes our extractor's output. Storing one in the other's field swaps one permanent false positive for another while looking fixed. May be empty ONLY before the first refresh_source_hashes run.
